h1: Buy Apple, Nvidia and Tesla with USDC — on Bybit
sub: Bybit now sells real US shares and ETFs — more than 1,000 of them — paid straight from the USDC in your Unified Trading Account. Orders start at 5 USDC and the market is open 24 hours a day, five days a week.
neutralLead: Below: what you own, how an order works, when you can trade and what the launch campaign pays.
facts: You buy US-listed shares. Alpaca Securities LLC (FINRA/SIPC member) executes the order and holds the shares in custody. Not a token, not a CFD.
Orders are paid and settled in USDC from your Unified Trading Account (UTA). No bank transfer needed.
Fractional shares on eligible stocks: put in 5 USDC and you own a slice of a share.
Pre-market, regular hours, post-market and an overnight session for supported stocks, Sunday evening to Friday evening (New York time).
stepsH: Your first stock order in 5 steps
steps: Register through NexuAlpha's link or enter invite code {code}, then complete Advanced Identity Verification. Stocks need the advanced level.
Deposit or convert to USDC and keep it in your Unified Trading Account. Stock orders are paid from there.
In the Bybit app or on the website, open TradFi and choose Stocks.
Type AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, QQQ or any of the 1,000+ symbols and open its trading page, with TradingView charts.
Choose Market or Limit, enter the amount (from 5 USDC) and confirm. The shares appear in your Bybit portfolio.

sessionsWeekend: Closed from Friday 8:00 PM to Sunday 8:00 PM ET and on US market holidays. Market orders fill in regular hours; outside them, choose 24-Hour Trading on a limit order.
campaignH: Full Stocks Ahead: 150,000 USDC for stock traders
campaignLead: Bybit's launch campaign runs from 12 October to 31 October 2026 (00:00 UTC). Register on the campaign page, then trade stocks in the Bybit app or on the website.
rewards: A reward for placing your first stock trade. Bybit shows the amount on the campaign page.
Trade more than $2,000 in stocks in a day and you get a box worth up to 50 USDC — every day of the campaign.
Trade at least $1,000 in stocks during the campaign and hold at least $1,000 in stocks at the end. The pool is shared by eligible volume, up to 5,000 USDC per person.

faq: Is Bybit Stocks available in my country?

Not in the United States, and not anywhere Bybit itself is unavailable (for example the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Singapore and Canada). Bybit also lists the EEA countries, India, Mauritius and the UAE as restricted for Stocks, with South Africa to be confirmed. Elsewhere you need a Bybit account with Advanced Identity Verification.

Yes. When you buy, you purchase US-listed shares that Alpaca Securities LLC (FINRA/SIPC member) holds in custody; Alpaca routes orders to venues such as NYSE and Nasdaq. They are not tokens or CFDs, so they cannot be sent on-chain.

Cash dividends are converted into USDC and credited to your Unified Trading Account after any withholding tax. Stock dividends arrive as extra shares, and splits adjust your position automatically. Shareholder voting is not available yet.
Bybit charges no commission. A service fee of 0.1% of the order value applies, at least 0.35 USDC per order, and the spread is built into the price.
How much do I need to start?
5 USDC. Eligible stocks can be bought in fractions, so the share price does not matter. A single order can be up to 1,000,000 USDC.
Can I trade at night or on weekends?
At night, yes: supported stocks trade overnight from 8:00 PM to 4:00 AM ET, next to pre-market and post-market. Weekends no: trading pauses from Friday 8:00 PM to Sunday 8:00 PM ET.
